pilot_shape: Veritas generates one non-executable paper order preview.
Randall manually places the paper order in the Alpaca UI.
OpenClaw reconciles the result later using read-only paper-account observations only.
No OpenClaw API submit, cancel, replace, live endpoint, account mutation, or money movement occurs.
entry_requirements: Explicit Randall approval for one manual pilot reconciliation scope.
Clean Phase 3 order-preview validator for the exact preview.
Phase 4 shadow-mode report acceptable for a one-order manual pilot.
Clean no-submit static/runtime guard proving no active submit/cancel/replace path exists.
Unexpired kill switch enabling read-only paper access only.
Audit-log validator proves append-only logging and secret redaction.
phase_5_manual_pilot_reconciliation.closeout_rule: Clean Phase 5 reconciliation proves only that manual-order reconciliation worked; it does not authorize OpenClaw submission or Phase 6.

phase_6_future_bounded_paper_execution.explicit_statement: Phase 6 is NOT approved for execution and no submit path may exist yet.
doctrine_exception_checklist: Randall explicitly acknowledges the exception to SOUL/USER/MEMORY no-order-submission doctrine.
Exception is paper-only, time-limited, ticker/order-limited, and revocable.
Live endpoint and live credentials remain forbidden with no fallback.
Submit scope is limited to simple paper limit orders only unless separately approved.
Cancel/replace/market/short/margin/leverage/options/crypto/complex orders remain blocked unless separately approved.
Independent audit confirms paper/live isolation, no live credential selection, no secret leakage, kill-switch behavior, audit logging, and failure-closed behavior.
Approval names exact wrapper, endpoint allowlist, risk caps, operator review step, and rollback/disable path.
Approval artifact validates before any code path capable of paper submission is merged or run.
Per-order owner approval remains required; model confidence, validation, and packet quality cannot infer approval.

no_submit_guard.default_rule: Fail if any active submit/cancel/replace path exists outside archived references and explicit documentation.
no_submit_guard.runtime_rule: Connectors default to GET-only until a separately approved Phase 6 transition exists.

kill_switch.default_behavior: Missing, malformed, expired, disabled, or contradictory state blocks every Alpaca call.
kill_switch.phase_6_future_state: Requires separate Randall-approved doctrine exception, short expiration, exact wrapper scope, and rollback instructions; not approved now.

secret_redaction_rules: Never persist or print API keys, secret keys, bearer tokens, auth headers, account secrets, raw environment values, or full request headers.
Replace any detected secret-shaped value with [REDACTED].
If redaction occurs, preserve only non-secret context and mark redaction_status=redacted.
Any unredacted secret blocks the workflow as a critical incident.
